description: Walls along a polyline of plan points (wall centre lines, mm). closed joins the last point back to the first. Corners join automatically. Default height 2700, thickness 200 (mm). bulges curves segments: bulges[i] is how far segment i (point i to the next) bows out at its middle, mm, + to the left going along the polyline, − to the right, 0 straight; at most half the segment's length (a half circle). type: a wall type (its layers set the thickness; the types are in the guide).

bulges.description: Per segment, mm; missing or 0 = straight

level.description: Level id or name (default: the active level)

items.description: Plan point in mm (x east, y north), relative to its level

name: create_walls
title: Draw walls
